HARDWIPE.Attack.SettingHint: Every targeted attack waits for GM approval, including GM rolls, NPC attacks, and attacks against player characters. Damage is applied only after confirmation. Natural 20s and 1s keep their critical hit or critical miss outcome, but also require confirmation. A melee hit 10 or more over AC proposes a critical. If approval cannot reach a GM, the workflow stops without applying damage.
